problem_text:
A city aims to devise a strategy for curbing digital traffic congestion by reducing packet loss from several network server nodes. Initially, no mitigation protocols have been implemented.

The characteristics of each server node are as follows:
* For Node 1, loss coefficient is 1.877, data throughput is 250.542.
* For Node 2, loss coefficient is 0.652, data throughput is 248.712.
* For Node 3, loss coefficient is 1.199, data throughput is 297.351.
* For Node 4, loss coefficient is 0.843, data throughput is 245.479.
* For Node 5, loss coefficient is 0.999, data throughput is 139.778.
* For Node 6, loss coefficient is 2.712, data throughput is 186.129.
* For Node 7, loss coefficient is 1.815, data throughput is 171.17.
* For Node 8, loss coefficient is 2.077, data throughput is 278.169.

To alleviate packet loss, several optimization algorithms are available, each characterized by a specific mitigation rate:
* By deploying Algorithm1, packet loss will be reduced by 50%
* By deploying Algorithm2, packet loss will be reduced by 59%
* By deploying Algorithm3, packet loss will be reduced by 76%
* By deploying Algorithm4, packet loss will be reduced by 64%
* By deploying Algorithm5, packet loss will be reduced by 72%
* By deploying Algorithm6, packet loss will be reduced by 18%
* By deploying Algorithm7, packet loss will be reduced by 28%
* By deploying Algorithm8, packet loss will be reduced by 85%

Implementing an algorithm on a node incurs an additional computational cost per unit of data throughput. The cost structure for all node–algorithm combinations is summarized below:

| Node \ Algorithm | Algorithm1 | Algorithm2 | Algorithm3 | Algorithm4 | Algorithm5 | Algorithm6 | Algorithm7 | Algorithm8 |
|--|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| Node 1 | 198.391 | 110.592 | 155.7 | 199.925 | 195.056 | 29.026 | 134.804 | 60.64 |
| Node 2 | 165.094 | 184.279 | 20.623 | 199.314 | 51.688 | 170.836 | 161.504 | 77.413 |
| Node 3 | 169.452 | 170.592 | 43.459 | 122.579 | 163.18 | 142.549 | 183.656 | 15.359 |
| Node 4 | 143.107 | 190.036 | 117.085 | 116.991 | 45.764 | 197.721 | 177.509 | 103.523 |
| Node 5 | 68.72 | 103.183 | 27.149 | 54.198 | 51.574 | 110.025 | 10.13 | 184.4 |
| Node 6 | 48.278 | 34.793 | 146.218 | 184.568 | 170.414 | 71.482 | 14.163 | 121.456 |
| Node 7 | 184.273 | 157.13 | 170.831 | 173.527 | 192.506 | 80.982 | 188.965 | 85.163 |
| Node 8 | 29.196 | 67.335 | 35.926 | 39.926 | 190.252 | 160.45 | 192.526 | 133.344 |

Please determine how to deploy optimization algorithms to each node (nodes may adopt multiple algorithms concurrently), and note that a node may also remain partially unoptimized if necessary. The objective is to ensure that the total packet loss is reduced by at least a proportion P = 0.287 of the initial loss, while minimizing the total computational cost.
